preconditions.description: The length of the genome n is between 4 and 255 inclusive.
The length of the string s is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ACGT?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of the characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '===' or (len([c for c in stdout if c in 'ACGT']) == n and all(stdout.count(c) == n // 4 for c in 'ACGT'))
postconditions.description: The output is either '===' or a valid genome string where each of 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T' appears exactly n // 4 times.
